name: Deliver Results
definition: Produce measurable outcomes rather than activity. What actually changed is the record, not how much was attempted.

rows.situation: When the update is a list of activity
rows.under: Reports what was done. Nobody can tell whether anything moved.
rows.justRight: Reports what changed for the customer or the number, and what is still missing.
rows.over: Reports only the headline number, and hides the work that is at risk.

rows.under: Waits, and reports the dependency as the reason.
rows.justRight: Finds the smaller path, the workaround, or the person who can unblock it now.
rows.over: Delivers by bulldozing a team that will have to live with what you built.

rows.situation: When the work is 80 percent done and something newer appears
rows.under: Moves to the new thing, and the old one stays at 80 percent forever.
rows.justRight: Finishes the current thing to a state that delivers value, then moves.
rows.over: Refuses to abandon work that has clearly stopped being worth finishing.

rows.under: Ships, and calls it a win because it went out.
rows.justRight: Names the number that would show this worked before you build it, then checks it after.
rows.over: Spends longer defining and instrumenting the measure than building the thing.

rows.situation: When the results did not come
rows.under: Explains the circumstances until the miss blurs.
rows.justRight: States the miss plainly, owns it, and says what changes next quarter.
rows.over: Punishes an honest miss so hard that the team starts sandbagging targets.
